title: Fracture Assessment
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Request it after the radiographs rather than instead of them, because the radiograph decides whether the scan is needed.
Review the axial images alongside coronal and sagittal reformats rather than one plane alone.
Assess the articular surface separately from the metaphysis, because they drive different decisions.
Record the dose, since this is a higher dose study than the radiographs it follows.
- Depression is measured against a reference that must be stated.
Repeat scanning through a treatment course accumulates dose in a population that is often young.
- The report should state the soft tissue question as open.
